facts.fact: On 7 July 2026 Chad's telecommunications minister told the ITU global AI governance dialogue in Geneva that Chad is running a national AI readiness diagnostic and drafting a national data governance strategy as a first step toward adopting a dedicated national AI strategy; no AI strategy is stated to be adopted or under drafting.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale dédiée à l'intelligence artificielle

facts.fact: UNECA reports Chad pre-validated its draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2027-2035 priorities) at an N'Djamena workshop, to be submitted to the Government by end-2026.

systems.owner: Ministry of Telecommunications, the Digital Economy and Digitalisation

facts.fact: A pre-validation workshop in N'Djamena reviewed Chad's draft National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2027-2035, drafted with the UN Economic Commission for Africa), which is to go to the government by the end of 2026.
The document says Chad's AI strategy has been pre-validated, with the ministry of telecommunications and digital economy leading.

note: The record's only line is a database's no; no fact.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that in October 2026 Chad held a workshop with the UN Economic Commission for Africa for a preliminary review of its draft National AI Strategy.

Agence Ecofin reports that Chad opened pre-validation work on 8 October on its National AI Strategy 2026-2030 at a ministry workshop supported by UNECA, and that the document has not yet been definitively adopted.
